title: Latin Fever
identity: Editions Marc Reift item EMR2227E is Scott Richards’s Latin Fever for alto saxophone and piano/keyboard, with optional drums, according to an exact-item retailer search result. Other Reift Latin Fever products have different saxophone scorings and are separate editions. No notation from EMR2227E was inspected.

evidence.claim: The local lead gives EMR2227E and optional percussion, but its current product page was not confirmed.
A Reift PDF search result identifies another Latin Fever, EMR5405, for alto saxophone, trombone (optional), and piano.
A second Reift score listing shows Latin Fever for soprano saxophone and piano/drums, an apparent separate scoring.

Exact item search result identifies EMR2227E as Scott Richards’s Latin Fever for alto saxophone and piano/keyboard, with optional drums. The product page could not be opened, so this is indexed retailer metadata rather than publisher-confirmed instrumentation.
Separate Reift Latin Fever products exist for alto saxophone, tenor saxophone and piano (EMR5394/5396) and for two soprano saxophones and piano (EMR56097); these are not the EMR2227E item.

review_focus: Confirm that the held edition is EMR2227E before evaluating its optional keyboard/drum parts or saxophone writing; no notation-specific demands are verified.
